challengePass.reason: The isolation mechanism itself now has strong direct evidence, but full exact-head CI is still running and the product-grade fail-closed effective-protection contract for arbitrary short-lived workloads remains unsolved. A separate diagnostics branch while that gate is active would create avoidable branch/CI churn.

nextExperiments: Finish PR #64 exact-head Ubuntu lane; if fully green, record the systemd mechanism as qualified experimental evidence but keep product support off main until effective-protection verification is race-safe for short-lived workloads.
Then run the same controlled opaque process failure plain versus narrowly filtered strace and measure added diagnostic signal, bytes, median/p95 overhead, and redaction.
Escalate to ProcMon/Inspektor Gadget/bpftrace only when the strace baseline demonstrably lacks required context.
Native crash pipeline remains ProcDump ELF core -> GDB 17.2; Chromium/Electron Crashpad .dmp remains a separate rust-minidump path.
guardrails: No product isolation capability is advertised from a test-only experiment.
Requested isolation may never silently degrade; shipping support needs effective-protection evidence.
Diagnostics are failure-only and additive; raw Ferrum evidence remains authoritative.
No target/data/evidence/fidelity caps, weakened tests, or reduced browser/app coverage.
No new diagnostics PR while the active isolation gate is incomplete unless a real production failure demands it.
